claims.statement: MECHANISM (a), engine-run with a closed allowlist, implemented in src/commands/capture.ts and recorded in the capture! help/README: the caller NAMES a command; the name must be one of the five FROZEN literals (npm test · npm run typecheck · npm run build · ann check · ann verify), each mapped to a fixed argv spawned with shell:false — no arbitrary string reaches an exec and the engine stays no general shell (the shell ability remains contract-declared and UNBUILT). GUARD = name-only closed set + a clean tree outside the ann store + the sha READ FROM GIT (never typed). REJECTED (b) runner-supplied capture with engine validation: it cannot produce the outcome (result stays typed by the reporter — the hole this task closes) and its guards are a strict subset of (a). Tests: 'is NOT A SHELL: only the five allowlisted names run' + the frozen-allowlist refusals.

A captured check is a FACT: {command, result (from the REAL exit code), detail (sha1 output digest over both streams + the last stdout line), sha (the bytes the run saw), source:'captured'} — Store.appendCaptured writes it through the SAME single writer, and the writer holds the fact self-consistent (sha + exitCode + detail required; result DERIVED from the exit code). DISTINGUISHABLE in the log from a REPORTED check: --checks on evidence! stays available but the single writer LABELS every unlabeled check 'reported', and a typed 'captured' is refused by name ('ENGINE-PRODUCED'). The card/UI prints the marker for every run. Tests: store 'an unlabeled check reads REPORTED' + 'refuses a TYPED captured check' + commands 'the log DISTINGUISHES a fact from a claim'.

Claims reduce to a MECHANICAL mapping: --claims '[{ac, check, statement?}]' — `check` names the RECORDED act that covers the AC; prose is optional and DERIVED at read time when absent ('verified by <check>'). The shape stays the store's single validation point (claimShapeProblem: `check` non-blank, at least one of check/statement) and the mapping is RESOLVED against the log by the store-derived check list (conclusion().claims[].bound), never re-derived in a binding. A mapping the log cannot resolve refuses the close by name (claim-unsubstantiated / claim-failed). Tests: store claim-shape cases; handlers 'a claim MAPPED to a check renders the resolution'; commands 'the ac→CHECK MAPPING is derived by the store'.

F-AC18 TIGHTENED, in ONE predicate (Commands.closeEvidenceBlocker) read by BOTH the close and the confirm-accept auto-close: commit evidence AND at least one CAPTURED pass bound to a cited commit (the LATEST check per command governs, so a failing re-run closes nothing). A reported-only conclusion is REFUSED BY NAME — no reason-string escape hatch: complete! → 'no-captured-pass' naming the fix, and gate! confirm accept leaves the task honestly 'accepted' with the blocker named in `pending`. Tests: the close cases (no checks · reported only · foreign sha · failing run) and the auto-close fixtures (every e2e close now captures first).
